technique_name: Generate an AI use case for a retail company.
description: AI can be used for a retail company to automate personalization of customer interactions. AI can identify customer profiles and interests, and then use that data to tailor messages, product recommendations, and specials that are sent to individual customers. Additionally, AI can be used to predict sales and inventory needs, enabling the company to respond quickly according to the needs of their customers.
